title: AuditTapReport v1 — the audit tap at a moment: its state stands first and loud — off, or on with the enabling operator, the moment, and the stated consent reason named (a tap left on is visible at a glance, threat T-10's careless-operator case); then the feed's truth: events retained, events seen, events filtered out by the policy's type filter, events dropped at the retention bound, reads served and events returned by them, retained counts by event type, every refusal counted apart by name, and every act's record — including the tap's own enabling and disabling; simulated is a constant — the tap judges events handed to it in-process, no socket was opened and no LAN crossed (Y-071)
